<!--
  Adding a comic? Awesome. The easy way:
  1. Create a folder: content/comics/your-comic-name/   (the folder name becomes
     the URL, e.g. /comic/your-comic-name/)
  2. Put your comic image inside it (PNG or JPG, ANY filename).
  3. That's it — open the PR. A meta.json (title, date, number) is generated
     automatically; you (or a maintainer) can edit the title/tagline later.

  Want to set the title + hover tagline yourself? Add a meta.json next to the
  image:
  {
    "number": 99,            // leave it out and it'll be auto-assigned
    "title": "Your Title",
    "altText": "the hover 'secret' tagline",
    "date": "2026-06-12"
  }
-->

## New comic 🖨️

**Comic title:**

**Hover tagline (optional):**

### Comic content guidelines
- [ ] It's about 3D printing / Bambu Lab and is safe-for-work.
- [ ] The comic image includes a **"BambuCD" logo** somewhere on it.
- [ ] No ads, no hyperlinks/URLs, no QR codes, no calls-to-action baked into the image.
- [ ] A small **"By: <your name/handle>"** credit on the comic is welcome (text only — no links).
- [ ] The artwork is mine / I have the right to publish it here.

### Licensing
- [ ] I understand contributions are released under this project's **AGPL-3.0** license.
